newsitem.title: USA: Twenty First Century says SEC plans visit.
newsitem.headline: Twenty First Century says SEC plans visit.

text.p: Twenty First Century Health Inc Tuesday said in conjunction with the investigation being carried out by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission into the viability of its glucose monitoring device, the SEC will visit Solid State Farms Inc.
Twenty First Century Health has an exclusive license to manufacture and market the non-invasive glucose meter invented by Milton Fuller of Solid State Farms.

"There are now two different working prototypes of the glucose meter, both using a superb patented radio frequency technology," according to Gregory Gilbert, chief executive officer of Twenty First Century Health. "One unit is designed to measure blood glucose levels daily for insulin users, and the other unit will measure AIC levels for all diabetics. Both take measurements with just a touch of the user's finger."
Twenty First Century Health and its international joint venture partner, Bio-Phile Inc, have already started limited clinical trials of the devices, the company said.
The company said it believes these trials will support filing a 510K application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
